What’s your midlife health costing you?
You’re an executive, a business owner or a busy professional who is constantly on the go, taking risks and achieving results.

You want to continue performing at your best, but you’ve hit midlife. The toll of the long work hours, eating on the go, juggling several personal and professional responsibilities, hormonal changes in the body, and the daily strain of high-pressure decisions has started to show.
Are you struggling with:
Sleep - Waking up between 2-4 am and lying there, wide awake?
Energy - Low energy and stamina, unable to keep up with your kids or grand kids?
Weight - It creeps up no matter what you eat or how you move?
Menopausal symptoms - Hot flushes, night sweats, or forgetting things?
Eating "well" - But still feeling lethargic and unable to concentrate?
Mid-afternoon energy slumps - Rescued by sugar, caffeine or nicotine?
Aches and pains - That flare up when you're overwhelmed or stressed?
Unsteady mood - On a short fuse snapping at your colleagues, partner or kids?
Stress - The pressure never seems to fade or you’re close to burning out?

blocks.text: I get it. I know how frustrating it is to try out different things but still feel like deep sleep, stable energy and a calm mind are out of reach.
You’re not lazy.
You’re not losing your mind.
Your body isn’t broken.

You’re in a different stage of life and your body needs a different kind of support. That's why, as a certified health, wellness and resilience coach and mid-lifer who recovered from burnout, I've made it my mission to help busy high-performers in demanding roles just like you get the help you need to feel energised, stable and strong - from the inside out. 

Together we'll untangle the patterns that are holding you back. We’ll use a blend of evidence-based information, mindset change, and nervous system regulating practises, to make simple and sustainable lifestyle upgrades, so you can finally start to work with your body rather than against it.
The Transformation
What happens when you have me by your side
Using my signature framework, we’ll correct the pattern, end the struggle and take back control.
Discover Your Root Cause.
Discover your unique root cause  Get clear on what is draining your energy, disrupting your sleep and adding to your stress—so you can address the root causes and make changes that last.
Master your mindset
Understand how your thoughts, beliefs and behaviours shape your daily choices and results—so you can make deeper and lasting changes.
Rebuild Your Rhythm.
Nutrition that truly nourishes

As a busy professional, your nutrition needs to match your schedule. Adjust your balance of protein, carbs and fats—and choose foods that fit your weekly schedule and energy needs. No more mid-afternoon energy crashes.
A whole person approach
Understand how sleep, energy, nutrition and your nervous system are connected—so you can make simple, lasting changes that support your wellbeing from more than one angle.
Strengthen Your Resilience.
Nervous System(NS) Regulation

Your nervous system sets the tone for how you show up.  When you feel calm and grounded, your energy often helps others feel calmer too. Recover faster from hard days with tools that you can use anywhere, anytime.
Clarity and Confidence
Structured support and accountability to turn what you learn into confident application. Get proven methods and support to trust yourself, build confidence and cope any change or challenge.
What makes my approach unique
Mindset audit

You take stock of your beliefs, values, behaviours, levels of self-efficacy, self-esteem and motivation. Shortcuts fail because the internal dialogue doesn’t change.  True transformation sticks when the unconscious becomes conscious – there’s no going back to unhealthy patterns once you see them.
You’re in the driving seat - always

You know your life and routine better than anyone else. I help you cut through the noise, get radically honest with yourself, provide you the information and tools to help you make smart choices that get you deep sleep, stable energy, and quick recovery.
Simple, high-impact strategies and a clear plan

No complex homework—just practical approaches that create immediate shifts without adding more to your plate. You walk away with a personalized roadmap that eliminates guesswork and builds lasting confidence in everyday decisions.

FAQs
Everything else you need to know
Frequently Asked Questions

My coaching and mentoring programmes are built for ambitious, capable people who are performing below their potential - not through lack of talent or strategy, but because their body needs a different operating system in midlife.

In midlife, you need more energy, self-trust and internal capacity to handle the demands that are placed on you. You deserve to wake rested, have steady energy, and handle daily stressors without lowering your standards, slowing your ambition or limiting your dreams.

If you've read the books, tried the habits, followed the latest trends, but haven’t got the results you were after or can't seem to make the results stick – my personalised coaching programmes are for you.
Who is this for?
A health coach is also a life coach, but focuses on helping you improve your health, nutrition and wellbeing.
A resilience coach helps you build the mental and emotional strength to cope with and bounce back from uncertainty, challenges and change.

Most coaches focus on one part of your life. A combination of  life, health and resilience coaching is unique and extremely powerful. I take a whole person approach because your energy, sleep, nutrition, stress, mindset and life direction are all connected. When one area is out of balance, all other areas feel the effects.
This joined-up and whole person approach is especially powerful in midlife, when your body, priorities and responsibilities are all shifting at once.

blocks.text: What it is
Collaborative partnership
An active partnership where you set the goals and direction. The coach holds space and reminds you of your strengths and capabilities.
Future focussed
Helps you move forward with a practical plan and tools. There’s no dwelling on the past and that’s one way coaching is different from therapy.
A realistic approach
Considers and accounts for your lifestyle, mindset, habits and barriers - not just the surface level facts.
Solutions oriented
Focusses on Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic and Time-bound actions that create lasting change.
What it isn’t
A guilt-tripping conversation
There isn’t any blaming, shaming or gaslighting.
Nor is it a gossip session or an offloading chat.
One way advice or ‘fixing’
You aren’t told what to do or handed a solution. There is nothing that needs ‘fixing’.
A quick fix
Real change takes time and consistency. There aren’t any instant solutions or approaches that work in silos.
Crisis support or medical intervention
Not suitable for urgent or severe mental or physical health conditions. Please seek help from your primary health care provider or other relevant support.
What is health, wellness and resilience coaching?
Because real transformation takes time. Long-term behavioural change happens through repetition and spaced reinforcement, not one-off breakthroughs.
Too short → no real groundwork for long-term behavioural change
Too long → loss of urgency, momentum and motivation

Everyone’s health and wellbeing needs are different. This is why different time frames are needed to interrupt old beliefs, habits and behaviours, install new ones, and reinforce them until they become automatic.

Think of it like planting a fruit tree in your garden. You don’t plant the seeds on Monday and expect results on Wednesday – You water and nourish the seed, a little each day, watch it blossom and yield fruits you can enjoy.
Why don’t you offer single session?
While each pathway has a different duration, I offer access to be flexible around your time commitments. These programmes are built to fit into your life.
Onboarding sessions (60-80 minutes)
Weekly coaching sessions (50 minutes)
Daily practises (depending on your personal goals 20-30 min)
It's roughly 3.0 - 3.5 hours a week - a similar amount of time you would spend watching TV or at the pub or at the gym.
How much time do I need?
Everyone’s situation is different, so I don't offer a one-size-fits-all package. Instead, we'll start with a conversation in your free, no-obligation discovery call.
Your Free Discovery Call
In this relaxed 30-minute call, we'll:
Talk about what's going on for you right now
Explore what you'd like to change and why it matters at this stage
Look at whether coaching and my approach is the right fit for you
Go through package options and fees, so you can select the option that suits you best
Packages start from £450.00
The real cost isn't the coaching package you select. The real cost is staying in patterns where:
Deep sleep remains out of reach and you don’t have energy, focus, concentration for everyday work and life.
Disconnected fixes add to your costs (mental, energetic and financial) and don’t give you results you were after.
Regular mid-afternoon energy crashes continue and lead to long-term metabolic health risks.
You feel older than you and don’t have the energy or vitality  to keep up with your loved ones.
Stress and overwhelm compound and your body goes into preservation mode rather than thrive.
Your personal relationships and professional performance are diluted.
Operating below your potential becomes the norm.
How much does it cost?
No problem! Coaching is a collaborative partnership between a coach (me) and a coachee (you).

A trained coach uses evidence-informed knowledge and a wide range of skills, strategies and tools to create a safe, supportive space for self-discovery, clarity to create goals and the structure and accountability to make sure you follow through on your commitments.
My role is to:
To create a safe, non-judgemental space to explore, embrace self-discovery.
Provide relevant information/resources, structure and accountability that will help you follow through and achieve your gaols.
Where relevant and necessary, challenge you to find new or more helpful perspectives.
Your role is to:
Own your goal(s) and take responsibility and accountability for the change you want to have in your life.
Taks action between sessions. This means trying new habits and reflecting on how they went.
Feeding back to me what is or isn't working, so the coaching can be adjusted.
I've never tried coaching before. What does it include?

Coaching is a collaborative partnership rather than an expert/client dynamic. As your coach and mentor, I will offer information and resources, where relevant and needed, but you have the final say on how you use the information and resources to move you towards your goals.
As my health coach, will you tell me what I should do?
That’s great! That usually means:
You understand the concepts in principle
But the principles haven't stuck

This programme exists for exactly that gap. This is not generic coaching – this is transformational coaching that is personalised to meet you where you are and consider your specific health, wellness and resilience goals.
What if I've tried coaching work before?
After the programme ends, you’ll have:
Installed helpful and supportive mental patterns
Evidence-based knowledge and practical tools to reinforce them
A system supported by resources that you can continue using independently

You can choose to continue fine-tuning your current life, health and wellness goals, or be supported on something new. Every one’s journey is different, and we’ll have time to have this chat before you end the programme.
What happens after the coaching programme ends?

About Me
About Me - 1

blocks.text: Hi! I’m Chunmun and I’m a Holistic Health, Wellness and Resilience Coach who is obsessed with an integrated approach to health and wellbeing.

I didn’t become a coach because it sounded appealing. I became a coach because I experienced first what happens when you ignore the signals that a body that is breaking down sends. I also experienced the power of having someone’s undivided attention and support to regain my health, confidence and capacity to overcome life’s hurdles and challenges.

My interest in personal development, psychology, mental wellbeing, and resilience began during an intense 5 -year period of, back‑to‑back midlife changes that led to health issues and eventually, burnout. Along the way, my body kept signalling that I something wasn’t right. Sometimes, I didn't understand the signals. At other times, I ignored them.

My body forced me to slow down and care for myself. Now, as a Health, Wellness and Resilience Coach, I use my lived experience and knowledge to help individuals in midlife have more energy, vitality and capacity for change.
